authorization: User explicitly requested implementation of A8 Snapshot / Seam after A7 main merge. Implementation, bounded repairs, CI, fresh review and evidence publication are authorized; A8 main merge is a separate human gate.

repair_r1.root_cause: Store recovery trusted syntactically valid CURRENT without a caller-owned durable acknowledgement floor; valid rollback/fork could revive an older executor lineage.
repair_r1.canonical_fix: Require exact external durable head anchor; public load accepts only equal/descendant chain, commit CAS requires exact anchored head. Preserve legitimate pre-pointer orphans and ambiguous descendant recovery.

validation_repair_r2.root_cause: The exact verifier created artifacts/a8/exact and later removed the entire artifacts/a8 parent before cold import, so cold-import.log and summary.json could not be created.
validation_repair_r2.repair_scope: validation/ecology/evo_arch2_a8/verify.py only; no A8 runtime, store, ticket, handoff, accepted A0-A7, registry or scheduler semantics changed.
validation_repair_r2.canonical_fix: Preserve the intended clean artifacts/a8 slate, then recreate artifacts/a8/exact before the first post-cleanup verifier log write.

validation_repair_r3.root_cause: Repair R2 recreated artifacts/a8/exact after cleanup but the already-passed 31-control log and its recorded SHA-256 were lost when the parent artifacts/a8 tree was removed, so a later PASS could reference evidence bytes absent from the uploaded artifact.
validation_repair_r3.repair_scope: validation/ecology/evo_arch2_a8/verify.py only; no runtime/store/ticket/handoff or accepted-main semantics changed.
validation_repair_r3.canonical_fix: Retain the exact store-control log bytes before cleanup, recreate the evidence directory, restore the bytes and fail closed unless the restored SHA-256 equals the already-recorded store-control digest.

runtime_repair_r4.root_cause: A8 added new SNAPSHOT_READY context fields with GDScript dictionary dot assignment. Those newly-created keys reached the canonical handoff state machine as StringName keys, while the canonical contract rejects every context key whose runtime type is not TYPE_STRING. SNAPSHOT_READY therefore failed with UNEXPECTED_TRANSITION_CONTEXT and the remaining A8 core failures cascaded from the unadvanced ticket.
runtime_repair_r4.repair_scope: scripts/research/ecology/v2/snapshot_seam_v1.gd only; canonical handoff_ticket.gd and handoff_state_machine.gd remain byte-identical to main.
runtime_repair_r4.canonical_fix: Create snapshot_hash and snapshot_id with explicit bracketed String dictionary keys before calling the canonical machine, preserving the canonical context type contract.

validation_repair_r5.root_cause: store_godot_integration.py used Python assert for fixture identity, Godot process success, crash outcomes, rollback rejection and final counts. Under -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE those guards disappear and could allow a false trusted PASS.
validation_repair_r5.repair_scope: validation/ecology/evo_arch2_a8/store_godot_integration.py only; runtime/store/ticket/handoff and accepted-main semantics unchanged.
validation_repair_r5.canonical_fix: Reject optimized Python unconditionally at module entry using sys.flags.optimize before any evidence assertion can execute; R6 preflight must exercise this rejection under PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1.

scope: Bounded full coupled A7 partition snapshot, canonical ticket handoff consumer, restart-safe command receipts and Linux durable CAS byte store with caller-owned external durable head anchors. Not production network activation or individual wet/dry transplantation.

Rewrite A4 field owner or A6 genesis during handoff
Treat store CURRENT as sufficient restart authority without an external acknowledged anchor
Main merge, A9/A10 dispatch or production promotion

resume_anchor.allowed_recovery_route: GitHub connector for source/evidence; repository-owned CI for exact execution; refetch PR #630 and R6 validation run by durable IDs
